verdicts.note: Subject explicitly self-identifies as the first female flight manager and repeatedly as a woman; female (2) clearly supported.
Subject is currently on her industrial placement ('I started my placement at the end of September'); Placement year (5) supported.
Subject is actively on placement, confirming she has gone on placement; yes (1) supported.
Emphatic de-prioritisation ('money doesn't matter', 'I couldn't care if I got paid £8,000') maps to very unimportant (1), stronger than merely unimportant (2).

Wanting 'to be in charge of a hell of a lot more' fits managerial (1) given she is already a Flight Operations Manager, but it is inferential (no explicit managerial-vs-technical statement); downgrade to low.
